audit_items.proof_trace: Polynomial multiplication operations occur exclusively within the external c-kzg-4844 library (v2.1.1), not in Prysm's codebase. The library is invoked via bindings in beacon-chain/blockchain/kzg/kzg.go through functions like RecoverCellsAndKZGProofs and ComputeCellsAndKZGProofs, which delegate to the C library. Degree validation is the responsibility of the external cryptographic library.
